method.books: >=100 levels Binance/Gate/MEXC (limit=100), up to 400 levels OKX (sz=400); all public, unauthenticated
method.execution: order book WALKED level by level to consume a target QUOTE (USDT) notional; average fill price = quote spent / base received; never derived from the mid
method.slippage: reported both vs top-of-book (opposite side best price) and vs mid
method.cex_leg_sell_cost_bps: taker_fee_bps + sell_slippage_vs_mid_bps; this is what a DEX->CEX cycle pays on the CEX side, it touches the CEX once
method.okx_taker_assumption: OKX taker fee could NOT be confirmed from a primary source; 10.0 bps assumed where a number was required, flagged everywhere

realised_volatility_1min.method: close-to-close standard deviation of 1-minute Binance klines, last 1000 bars
realised_volatility_1min.why_it_matters: A DEX-CEX cycle is NOT atomic: it requires an on-chain transfer between the two venues. Binance publishes minConfirm=1 and estimatedArrivalTime=1 minute for the Solana network. Over a 1-minute exposure window the 1-sigma price move is 7.6 bps (SOL) to 23.0 bps (BONK) - larger than the entire measured edge budget.
